svg.title: Data, representation, and computation
svg.desc: An original conceptual research diagram. Controlled changes to a corpus feed a layered representation field. Frozen-backbone probes and oracle-conditioned readout ask different questions about accessible information. Hidden reasoning, regret, and context-free grammar learning remain research questions. Points and paths are illustrative, not measured embeddings or evidence of causality.
svg.metadata: Original editorial illustration for Zhaibin Cui. Method context: https://github.com/Zhaibin-Cui/mini-train-sys . No experimental measurements are plotted.
svg.text: Change one condition. Trace what changes. Test what the model can recover.
Layer states · token positions · routing patterns
Hidden reasoning · regret · CFG · architecture and data interactions
Illustrative points and paths, not measured embeddings. Ongoing research directions are not reported experimental findings.
